name: Suku x Suku
source:
The top performers of Soccer, Rythmic Gymnastics, Swimming; as well as a member of the Student government, and even the chief of the Manga Club. Each of these girls will be the target of the Student Government president. Our president has been a popular and proper individual--hence he was voted into said position. That was until the discussion of extracurricular budgeting came about. Thus, the best (and most attractive) of the aforementioned clubs have been sent to our president to “convince” him not to close down their respective clubs. It’s good to be president!

[Vague Game Description by White Masq]
translation:
足球、艺术体操、游泳的顶尖运动员；也是学生会的成员，甚至是漫画社的社长。这些女孩中的每一个都将成为学生会主席的目标。我们的总统是一个受欢迎的、正派的人——因此他被选为这个职位。直到关于课外预算的讨论出现。因此，上述俱乐部中最好的（也是最有吸引力的）已被发送给我们的总统，以“说服”他不要关闭各自的俱乐部。当总统真好！

[White Masq的模糊游戏描述]
